title: MONTH_24 — Occupation & Physical Activity
description: Changes in physical activity, transport, screen time, stair climbing, work hours, travel to work and the leisure-activity items (frequency, hours and minutes) from the 24-month questionnaire.
$comment: The source gives no 999 for these items. Leisure-activity column names (leis_<activity>Freq/Hrs/Min plus the _24m suffix) follow the group row 'leis_cswim ... _24m' and are unconfirmed (D012).

oneOf.title: 2 to 3 times in the last 4 weeks

leis_frequency.$comment: Source: 'leis_cswimFreq, 1 = None, 2 = Once in the last 4 weeks, ... 7 = Every day' - the same seven codes for every leisure activity. The source gives no 999.

work_type_24m.title: What type and amount of physical activity is involved in your work?

oneOf.title: Sedentary occupation i.e. you spend most of your time sitting (such as in an office)
Standing occupation i.e. you spend most of your time standing or walking. However, your work does not require intense physical effort (e.g. shop assistant, hairdresser, guard)
Manual work i.e. involves some physical effort including handling of heavy objects and use of tools (e.g. plumber, electrician, carpenter)
Heavy manual work i.e. this implies very vigorous physical activity including handling of very heavy objects (e.g. dock worker, miner, brick layer, construction worker).
